title: XProf installation and demo-profile smoke test
objective: Install XProf and validate profile discovery, available analysis tools, and browser rendering against the official preserved demo profiles.
description: Executed locally with the stable xprof 2.22.3 package and two raw XPlane demo profiles extracted from the pinned source snapshot; the browser UI and Graph Viewer were subsequently inspected manually.
expected_outputs: Two discovered demo sessions and their supported-tool lists
actual_outputs: HTTP 200 from the XProf root page
Each session exposed ten analysis tools including overview, trace, graph, memory, roofline, framework-op and HLO views
Manual browser inspection confirmed both sessions and rendered HLO graphs
The Capture Profile dialog opened; no new workload profile was captured
notes: Paper-scale evaluation inputs and commands are not present in the upstream repository.
The test used the stable binary package rather than building revision 713b05f09e30 from source.
Capture Profile requires a separately running compatible profiling service and is outside this demo-profile experiment.
metadata_gaps: DAS-6 collection and distributed-processing environments remain unvalidated.
No new JAX or TensorFlow computation has been captured.
